extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agents evaluator configuration screen in an "Edit evaluator" form. A deterministic evaluator named "Calculation Evaluator" is configured with the "Exact Match" type, a description explaining exact string matching, and the target output field set to "Calculation". The name field and target output field are visually highlighted.
extraction.step_instructions:
In the Name field, enter "Calculation Evaluator".
Select "Deterministic" from the Category dropdown.
Select "Exact Match" from the Type dropdown.
In the Description field, enter "An evaluator that checks for exact string matches between expected and actual outputs".
In the Target output fields field, enter "Calculation".
